title: Petition of Boston Edison Company for authority to construct, maintain and operate certain underground transmission lines under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 72, and for a determination that locations upon, under, along or across certain boulevards or reservations in the care and control of the Metropolitan District Commission will be and are required by public convenience and necessity for wires, cables or pipes for the transmission of electricity under the provisions of G.L. c. 92, § 43.
